text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing about Vodka's decision to abruptly change tours, Daiwa Scarlet calls her "lame" to her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka contends that she's just staying true to her own definition of cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She poses a question to Daiwa Scarlet—what does being number one really mean to her?
